installed_optional_platform.review: Inspected package metadata and bundled SBOM. Native dependency includes additional libraries and has no standalone package license file. Native redistribution is not approved by this browser-only review; production assets must exclude this package and all native/ICU files.

policy.input: Backend-verified retained owned report PDF bytes, never a URL or arbitrary uploaded PDF.
policy.worker: Explicit dedicated same-origin module Worker; destroyed on close, identity change, failure or deadline. No silent fake-worker fallback.
policy.fetch: No PDF URL, no auxiliary resource fetch, useWorkerFetch=false, rejecting BinaryDataFactory.
policy.fonts: Embedded report font outlines only; useSystemFonts=false and disableFontFace=true.
policy.actions: No annotation/form/text-link layer, XFA, attachments, PDF scripting sandbox or action dispatch.
policy.eval: Pinned core and worker have no eval()/new Function constructor path. isEvalSupported was removed by this PDF.js version, so setting false is explanatory rather than a relied-on control.
policy.csp: worker-src self; script-src self; no blob/remote worker, unsafe-eval, frame or PDF object permission required.
policy.limits_disclosure: maxImageSize can omit oversized PDF raster images. The preview discloses this bound and is not a completeness or integrity check; verified original PDF bytes remain available.
policy.boundary_note: Component and retained-product IPC use the same 8 MiB bound.

verification.typescript: passed after replacing obsolete document.destroy with loading-task.destroy
